Welcome to 38141 Seneca Circle, a custom 2019 estate on 2.27 acres in the heart of Temecula Wine Country. At the heart of the home is a beautifully appointed kitchen, boasting expansive counter space and abundant storage to inspire your inner culinary artist.The private primary suite serves as a serene sanctuary, opens up to a balcony with a view of the mountains to complete there is a luxurious en-suite bathroom . Three additional versatile bedrooms provide the ultimate flexibility, easily transforming into premium guest suites, a dedicated home office, or a vibrant playroom to suit your lifestyle.Step outside into your own private paradise. The resort-style backyard features a sparkling pool with waterfall, hot tub and real rick features. Fresh lush grass, and impeccably manicured landscaping. Whether you are hosting weekend barbecues, dining alfresco, or stargazing by the water, this outdoor oasis is built for making memories.Living in Crowne Hill means access to premium community amenities, including pristine parks, playgrounds, scenic walking trails, picnic areas, and basketball courts. Nestled within the enrollment boundaries of top-rated schools including Crowne Hill Elementary and Temecula Valley High School, this property is also just minutes from excellent shopping, dining, and the award-winning estates of Temecula Valley Wine Country.Schedule a viewing today and envision the life that awaits you at 43033 Manchester Ct!

results.remarks: Welcome to this beautifully appointed Temecula home built by Warmington sitting on a quarter acre lot with fully paved RV parking and an extra large newly resurfaced pebbletec POOL with brand new tile, pool pump and jacuzzi jets, this home has parking room for 7 vehicles plus a large RV. This home is in a prime location, tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac adjacent to the Meadowview Community with acres of horse riding and hiking trails. There are 4 bedrooms or technically 3 bedrooms and a bonus room with a fireplace. Additionally the master bedroom has a retreat room which can be made into a 5th bedroom and a full walk-in closet. There is grand total of 3 brick wood burning fireplaces! Upon entering, this home opens up to a huge living room with a double set of French doors on each side of the fireplace and brand new wood flooring, baseboards, casings and rubbed bronze fixtures throughout. With fresh interior paint, the entire home feels bright & spacious. The living room is perfectly sized for family gatherings and the kitchen offers tons of countertop & cabinet space, along with a cute breakfast nook for early mornings. The family room provides privacy and has it’s own fireplace. Moving upstairs you will see the sizable guest bedrooms and bonus room with new blinds & ceiling fans, sharing a full guest bath with dual vanities. The master is huge and comes with a retreat room for lounging and relaxing with dual vanities, a walk in shower & separate soaking tub.Moving to the backyard, you will find your private oasis with starting with a large patio cover spanning the entire width of the house ,stucco and brick walls surrounding the perimeter of the property with new white vinyl gates with a separate outside entrance to the huge pool and jacuzzi which sit to the side allowing for full usage of the entire back yard. There is a ton of grass area for kiddos or pets to run around & play.and a tether ball and basketball hoop. Near the pool is also a dedicated fire pit area which is perfectly for summer night hangouts! Additional benefits to this property are the higher end irrigation system set up on timers in front and back and planter areas, walking distance to the middle school & even the grocery store! Come see this home in person to experience how fantastic it would be to live in it! It is move in ready today!

results.remarks: Welcome to The Fairways. An enviable golf course lifestyle in a gated community, perched with view of the 4th Hole on the course. Step outside to enjoy the serenity this select, premium lot offers on the golf course. The palapa and bubbling spa with serene views makes for the perfect setting for morning coffee or relaxation. The outdoor built in BBQ kitchen with refrigerator is quite the score for entertaining! Covered with a New Roof (2023) this floor plan includes 3 bedrooms + a den/office, plus an upper built-in home office desk, 3 baths, a 3-car garage and indoor laundry room w sink and cabinetry. Generous living areas filled with views that take advantage of the home’s outstanding location. The primary suite view is stunning, soaking tub, and enormous walk-in closet! An upgraded interior showcases quality finishes and thoughtful details. Location, schools, lifestyle and luxury! The prominent developer afforded the owner to make exceptional upgrades in the building process and owner has continued to make improvements that are far above average; French doors, slate flooring, arched openings, granite countertops and fireplace hearth, insulated interior walls & floor joists, built in wine closet, smooth level 5 drywall, reverse osmosis, 4 paradigm in-wall speakers with volume control, garage cabinetry + epoxy flooring being installed, windows/doors wired for alarm, attic fans thermostat controlled, patio cover/large lumber sandblasted, faced and capped 80’ retaining wall, ceiling fans, 10 palms + more shade trees, golf cart sized gate, plus more (see attached supplemental). Close proximity to all that Temecula has to offer; schools, shopping, restaurants, hospital and wineries!! See and appreciate – don’t miss this one!

results.remarks:
POOL HOME - Welcome to this beautifully maintained 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom home offering 2,708 square feet of living space on a spacious 8,276 sq ft lot in the highly desirable Wolf Valley Estates community, with low HOA. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac and zoned for Great Oak High School, this property combines comfort, functionality, and an incredible lifestyle.
Step inside to soaring vaulted ceilings and an abundance of natural light. The thoughtfully designed floor plan includes a convenient downstairs bedroom and full bath, ideal for multi-generational living, guests, or a private home office. The interior features hard-surface flooring throughout the downstairs, modern white shaker cabinetry, and upgraded stone countertops that create a clean, timeless aesthetic.
The backyard is an entertainer's dream, complete with a sparkling pool and spa, a tall rear privacy wall, and a charming white picket-fenced area that adds a touch of country character. Enjoy harvesting your own oranges, raspberries, blackberries, and grapes right from your backyard while taking in spectacular seasonal fireworks displays thanks to the home's convenient proximity to Pechanga Resort Casino.
Thoughtfully upgraded for comfort and efficiency, the home features a solar system (leased,) dual AC units, and dual-pane windows that were replaced approximately two years ago. Over the past +/- 5 years, the sellers have also installed a tankless water heater, a new pool heater, and a new downstairs AC unit, giving buyers added peace of mind and helping minimize future maintenance concerns.
Additional highlights include a large front yard, a two-car attached garage, and a location just minutes from Birdsall Sports Park, making weekend baseball, football, and soccer tournaments incredibly convenient for active families.
This is a rare opportunity to own a spacious, upgraded home that perfectly blends privacy, entertainment, and everyday convenience in one of South Temecula's most sought-after communities.

results.remarks: Step into a home with FULLY PAID Solar and where space, style, and resort-style living come together effortlessly.** Offering an impressive 3,674 sq. ft. with 5 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and a 3-car garage, this Roripaugh Ranch residence was designed with both everyday comfort and entertaining in mind. The main level welcomes you with upgraded laminate plank flooring and an expansive open layout where the great room, dining area, and kitchen flow naturally together, highlighted by quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and stylish lighting. A flexible bonus room gives you the freedom to create the perfect game room, formal dining space, or lounge, while a DOWNSTAIRS BEDROOM and FULL BATHROOM offer an ideal setup for guests, a private office, or multigenerational living. Upstairs, escape to a spacious primary suite featuring two walk-in closets and a spa-inspired bathroom with a rain shower, soaking tub, and dual vanities, while each of the three additional oversized bedrooms includes its own walk-in closet. The backyard is just as impressive, creating a private setting to unwind or entertain with a stone fireplace, Alumawood patio cover, tranquil koi pond and waterfall, dedicated dog run, and gas and water hookups ready for a future outdoor kitchen. Beyond the home, the gated Roripaugh Ranch community brings the resort experience to your doorstep with a pool, spa, clubhouse, fitness center, tennis and basketball courts, and private walking trails. **Spacious inside, unforgettable outside, and surrounded by amenities—this is Roripaugh Ranch living at its best.

results.remarks: Welcome to a home that makes everyday feel a little more special. Set on a desirable corner lot in Temecula’s Wolf Creek community, and in the Great Oak High School boundaries, this well-kept two-story residence offers the space, flexibility & resort-style backyard setting that make it easy to picture your next chapter here. Step through the arched entry into a bright foyer with soaring ceilings, tile flooring & graceful architectural details that carry throughout the home. At the heart of the home, the kitchen opens naturally to the dining area & expansive family room, creating a comfortable setting for everyday routines, holiday gatherings & relaxed weekends at home. Granite countertops, maple cabinets, recessed lighting, a generous wraparound breakfast bar, abundant original cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting & a central island make the kitchen as functional as it is welcoming. Upstairs, all bedrooms are thoughtfully located together, creating a clear separation between the private living spaces & the areas designed for hosting. The spacious primary suite feels like a true retreat with an attached sunlit bonus space that can serve as a private office, reading nook, fitness area. Its en-suite bathroom features dual vanities, a soaking tub, separate glass-enclosed shower, tile flooring & an easy connection back to the bedroom. An upstairs loft expands the home’s living space even further, offering its own fireplace & plenty of room for a media lounge, game room or homework zone. The additional bedrooms are comfortably sized & versatile, while the upstairs hall bath includes a dual-sink vanity & shower/tub combination. Enjoy warm afternoons in the built-in pool, relax in the elevated spa, or host a weekend barbecue beneath the expansive covered patio with ceiling fans & room for outdoor dining. Lovingly maintained, this home provides a clean, cared-for canvas to enjoy today or personalize over time. Nearby HOA amenities include a clubhouse, resort-style pool & spa, playgrounds, green space & gathering areas. This South Temecula location is the preferred destination for San Diego Commuters, just 10 minutes to the 15 South with convenient access to parks & recreational destinations, Birdsall Sports Park offering sports fields, ball diamonds, playgrounds & open space. Temecula’s schools, shopping, dining, entertainment, Old Town Temecula, Pechanga Resort & Wine Country are all within minutes, making it easy to enjoy everything this vibrant area has to offer.

Welcome to an exceptional home in the highly sought-after Lake Harveston community, where tree-lined streets, resort-style amenities, and a picturesque lakeside setting create an inviting neighborhood atmosphere.

This beautifully maintained residence offers 4 bedrooms, 4 full bathrooms, and a spacious loft/bonus room featuring a custom built-in mahogany Murphy bed and bookcases. This versatile space is ideal for a home office, media room, playroom, guest retreat, or potential 5th bedroom.

Step through the grand entry and experience an immediate sense of space, with dramatic 22-foot ceilings, abundant natural light, wide hallways, and an elegant open staircase. The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers generous living spaces with a comfortable flow for both everyday living and entertaining.

The gourmet kitchen combines style and functionality with granite countertops, rollout cabinetry, a decorative backsplash, and premium GE Profile appliances.

Designed for Southern California indoor-outdoor living, the backyard is an entertainer's dream. Enjoy a built-in Jenn-Air BBQ and griddle, sink, under-counter refrigerator, bar seating, and multiple covered patio areas. Mature lemon, apple, pear, and guava trees are complemented by colorful roses and flowering vines, creating a private and inviting outdoor retreat.

The spacious primary suite features a professionally designed his-and-hers walk-in closet system, providing exceptional organization and storage.

Numerous upgrades enhance comfort, efficiency, and convenience, including a 27-panel solar system with backup battery, whole-house water purification system, UV and heat-reducing window coatings, Google Nest video doorbell, and monitored security system.

Best of all, the home is located just one block from the lake and close to Harveston's impressive community amenities, including the clubhouse, pool, spa, splash pad, playgrounds, parks, and pedal boats. The scenic 0.8-mile paved trail surrounding the lake provides a beautiful setting for walking, jogging, and biking.

Immaculately maintained and rarely available, this exceptional home combines generous living space, thoughtful upgrades, outstanding outdoor entertaining, and the distinctive Lake Harveston lifestyle.

results.remarks: Welcome to the prestigious gated community of Vintage at Redhawk, where elegant living meets one of South Temecula's most sought-after locations. Renowned for its award-winning schools, beautiful parks, convenient shopping and dining, and quick access to I-15 and San Diego County, this neighborhood is a favorite for both families and commuters alike. This exceptional floor plan offers a combination of flexibility and privacy, featuring a private entry casita complete with its own full bathroom, plus an additional main-floor bedroom and full bath within the main home—ideal for multi-generational living, or income-producing rental opportunity. Step inside the main home to soaring ceilings and an abundance of natural light that fill the formal living and dining rooms. The dining room opens to a charming side courtyard, creating the perfect setting for indoor-outdoor entertaining. Tile flooring extends throughout the main traffic areas, while the inviting family room features plantation shutters, a cozy fireplace, and custom media built-ins. The spacious kitchen opens seamlessly to the family room and is appointed with maple cabinetry, a large center island, walk-in pantry, butler's station, upgraded black stainless appliances, and abundant storage. Upstairs, LVP flooring and striking faux wood beams create warmth and character throughout the hallway. The second level offers four additional bedrooms plus a versatile loft office. One secondary bedroom enjoys its own private en-suite bath and walk-in closet, while the remaining bedrooms feature custom closet built-ins and share a well-appointed hallway bath. The primary suite is a true retreat with its own fireplace, sitting area, dual custom walk-in closets, and an elegant en-suite bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and separate shower. The backyard is designed for relaxation and entertaining with a custom spool featuring dual Baja shelves, cascading water features, and a sunken spa. Mature landscaping, a raised seating area, and picturesque mountain views create a peaceful setting, while 4th of July fireworks from Pechanga Resort can be enjoyed right from your own backyard. Additional upgrades include a Tesla charging station, whole-house water filtration system, and a newer HVAC system. Meticulously maintained and showcasing true pride of ownership, this remarkable home offers an exceptional blend of luxury, functionality, and flexibility in one of South Temecula's premier gated communities.

results.remarks: Tucked toward the end of a quiet, no-through street, offering a cul-de-sac-style setting with minimal traffic and added privacy, this single-level residence is privately set on approximately 2.65 acres and welcomes you with a long, tree-lined driveway framed by mature landscaping and a peaceful Wine Country setting. The approach creates a true sense of arrival, while the home showcases a clean ranch-style façade, attached garage, wide frontage, and low-maintenance grounds complemented by shade trees and thoughtfully spaced plantings. The backyard unfolds as a private outdoor retreat, featuring a pool and spa surrounded by mature trees and scenic natural surroundings. Multiple patio areas provide space for entertaining, relaxing, and embracing the indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The expansive lot offers a blend of usable land and natural landscape, with room for gardening, recreation, or future possibilities, while a gated side yard and extended pathways enhance functionality and access throughout the property. Inside, the home is light and bright with fresh interior paint, new light fixtures and electrical outlets throughout, durable vinyl plank flooring, and a functional single-level layout designed for comfortable living. Two spacious living areas with high ceilings create an open, airy feel, enhanced by large windows and sliding glass doors that bring in natural light and provide seamless access to the outdoor spaces, while a fireplace adds warmth and character to the main living area. The updated kitchen features white shaker cabinetry, white crystal quartz countertops with a matching 6-inch backsplash, and new appliances, along with a convenient pass-through that enhances flow between living spaces—ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The home offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a hall bathroom with dual sinks and a refurbished tub, complemented by updated vanities throughout for a clean, refreshed look. The expansive primary suite stands out with its generous size, unique closet configuration—featuring dual closets connected by a walk-in layout with a dedicated vanity/dressing area—and a spacious primary bathroom highlighted by an oversized soaking tub, creating a relaxing, spa-like retreat. An interior laundry room with direct outdoor access adds everyday convenience. Set within the heart of Temecula Wine Country and located in the prestigious community of Glenoak Hills, the property enjoys a scenic and private setting surrounded by rolling hills, estate homes, and nearby vineyards. Community amenities include two tennis courts, a clubhouse, horse arena, and playground. Just minutes from Temecula’s renowned wineries along the De Portola Wine Trail —featuring Leoness, Altisima, Fazeli, and Renzoni—this location offers the perfect balance of rural tranquility and modern convenience. Enjoy low HOA fees and the flexibility of a 2.65-acre parcel with potential for a guest house, ADU, horse facilities, RV garage, or even the opportunity to cultivate your own vineyard or avocado grove—tailored to your Wine Country lifestyle

results.remarks: STUNNING SINGLE-STORY HOME IN THE HIGHLY DESIRABLE SOMMERS BEND COMMUNITY!!! Offering 3 bedrooms plus an office and 3 bathrooms, this beautifully appointed home immediately impresses with its exceptional curb appeal, drought-tolerant landscaping, and inviting oversized front porch. Inside, sophisticated modern finishes combine with an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Soaring ceilings and an expansive great room create an inviting sense of space, complemented by gorgeous dark wood cabinetry and accents, while the kitchen features quartz countertops, a farmhouse sink, soft-close cabinetry, and sleek Café appliances with smart-home functionality. A Simplifire fireplace anchors the living area, while a dramatic set of double sliding doors opens directly to the California Room. The spacious primary suite offers a private retreat with a beautifully appointed ensuite bathroom featuring a generous walk-in shower, dual vanities, and modern cabinetry, along with a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms provide plenty of space for family and guests, while the dedicated office offers the perfect work-from-home space. A separate laundry room adds convenience and functionality. Step outside to a low-maintenance backyard featuring lush turf, creating an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining, or simply enjoying the Southern California lifestyle. Custom window coverings, solar panels, and modern smart-home features add comfort, convenience, and efficiency to this exceptional home. Located in the sought-after Sommers Bend community, residents enjoy an exceptional collection of amenities designed for an active Southern California lifestyle, including parks, walking and biking trails, playgrounds, and sports facilities. The community's Sports Ranch offers baseball and soccer fields, basketball courts, picnic areas, BBQs, and a playground, creating plenty of opportunities for recreation and gathering. With its modern comfort, seamless blend of indoor and outdoor living, and community amenities, this exceptional single-story home truly has it all.

results.remarks:
New price!!  $1,050,000.
A beautiful, very spacious, single story home in the fabulous Meadowview equestrian community with easy access to the 350 acre open meadow--READY TO MOVE IN NOW!  There are two virtual tours--one a walk thru and a streaming video with virtual furniture. 
Meadowview is RURAL living right next to the Promenade Mall, Lowes, Trader Joe and Winco.
Entertaining family and friends iss a breeze with the large living room, dining area and most of all a HUGE bonus room accessible to the equally huge covered patio.  
Afterwards can relax in two spacious bedrooms and a large ensuite primary bedroom with sizable walk in closet and rear yard access.
Every interior aspect has been refreshed with new wall switches and outlets, LED can and ceiling lights, painting, bath fixtures and professional cleaning of EVERYTHING!.  Plus windows upgraded to energy efficient vinyl windows.
The exterior rejuvenation spans pressure washing, wood trim and fascia and stucco repair, top to bottom painting including the patio cover--in essence NO maintenance for years to come.
The spacious three car garage is overflowing with cabinets, shelving and work benches plus there is a detached shed with power for even more storage.  Garage doors are insulated as well.  To the left of the garage side is a space for RV parking.
Big advantage is the approximately 1/3 acre usable back yard with two flat areas ideal for a pool and entertainment complex. Very unusual is the natural gas for heating and cooking--much more economical than propane tanks that have to be refilled.
To reiterate this lovely, comfortable home is READY TO MOVE IN NOW! 
Become part of this wonderful community that will be your forever home!  
Please submit preapproval letter with offer.

results.remarks: Welcome to this charming, remodeled home in the heart of Temecula Wine Country! This fully upgraded residence perfectly blends town convenience with rural charm. An inviting deck leads you into an open floor plan adorned with laminate flooring and plantation shutters throughout. The removal of walls has created a bright and airy atmosphere. The kitchen, remodeled in 2017, features stunning quartz countertops, white cabinets with black hardware, stainless steel appliances, and a breakfast bar with seating. The spacious formal dining and family rooms provide ample space for gatherings. results.remarks: Home is where every holiday memory begins. You will discover how special this home feels the minute  you step through the front door into a foyer that immediately wraps you in warmth. The formal living and dining rooms are made for hosting,  think holiday toasts, a beautifully set table, and all the people you love under one roof. The family room is the true heart of the home. Gather around the fireplace and string popcorn & berries.  The large office with warm wood paneling offers a cozy place to enjoy working during the season.  Imagine the aroma of a holiday feast coming together as you look out over your own private winter wonderland in the spacous kitchen. The grand staircase leads to 4 generously sized bedrooms and 3 bathrooms. The primary suite is a true retreat, complete with a private deck to enjoy a cup of cocoa under the stars. The primary bathroom with double vanities, a walk-in shower, and a separate soaking tub is the  ideal  space for unwinding after a busy day of holiday hosting. Two large secondary bedrooms with a Jack & Jill bathroom  make the perfect place for the rest of the family. The additional bedroom & bathroom offer another room for addiional family or guests. The  brand new A/C unit, assures comfort is covered no matter the season. The outdoor space is also ready to spread holiday cheer. Set on nearly 1/2 an acre, it offers generous space for gardening, recreation, and outdoor cooking. The multiple seating areas are perfect to gather under the stars and sip cocoa.  There's plenty of room for horses,  plus a large three-car garage, storage shed, and gated parking for your RV, boat, toy hauler, classic car, or that new adult toy you wished for. The Meadowview community sits on 360 beautifully maintained acres, with 23 miles of hiking and riding trails for crisp winter walks. When it's time to celebrate together, residents enjoy exclusive access to pickleball courts, basketball & tennis courts, 2 pools + a kiddie pool, a  clubhouse,  and  an equestrian arena,  amenities that make this community feel like home all year long. Temecula is a place to call home any time of the year. The beautiful wineries, top rated schools, convenient shopping, and diverse dining are  just minutes away. Perfect for celebratating and discovering new holiday traditions together.  This is more than a house, it’s a place to create memories that last a lifetime. Come see why this could be the home you come back to, every holiday, for years to come.

Perched to capture sweeping panoramic views, this home delivers something truly rare: amazing valley and mountain views with spectacular mountain sunsets, followed by the glow of city lights across the valley below — a must see. Morning coffee as the mountains catch first light, evening on the patio as the sun drops behind the ridgeline and the valley lights come alive — here, the scenery becomes part of everyday life. Inside, the open-concept floor plan creates an inviting flow centered around the spacious kitchen and living areas — perfect for everyday living and entertaining alike. The generously sized primary suite provides a private retreat with ample space to unwind and all the amenities you could want, including dual closets for exceptional storage and convenience. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, a home office, or hobbies. Beyond the home, Morgan Hill offers an outstanding collection of resort-style amenities designed for an active and relaxed Southern California lifestyle. Residents enjoy a beautiful clubhouse, sparkling pool and spa, sports courts, and multiple parks and gathering spaces — many with their own beautiful views and peaceful surroundings. And you're just minutes from Temecula Wine Country and Old Town, where fall brings harvest festivals, hot air balloons, and the valley's perfect autumn weather — warm days and cool evenings made for sunset views from your own backyard. With its desirable single-story design, spacious interiors, exceptional primary suite, and truly captivating mountain, valley, and city light views, this Morgan Hill home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy the best of South Temecula living.

results.remarks: SELLER MOTIVATED!!! Welcome to this meticulously maintained and beautifully upgraded 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home with solar, ideally situated on a quiet cul-de-sac in Temecula’s desirable Tradewinds community. Offering an exceptional blend of style, comfort, privacy, and low-maintenance living.This home is  designed for both everyday enjoyment and effortless entertaining. One of the property’s most distinctive features is its wonderfully private setting with no rear neighbors. Inside, you’ll find easy-care luxury vinyl flooring, timeless 4" plantation shutters and ceiling fans throughout. Enjoy two quite cool fans, Milgard energy efficient windows, a whole house water filtration system and upgraded heating and air systems! The remodeled kitchen combines functionality with timeless style. Gorgeous cabinetry, upgraded counters, trash compactor, pull-out drawers, and upgraded stainless-steel appliances make this kitchen as practical as it is inviting. Thoughtfully updated bathrooms feature stylish vanities and contemporary finishes. The backyard has a lovely Alumawood patio cover with custom roller shades providing welcome protection from the sun while adding an additional layer of privacy. The low-maintenance artificial lawn & putting green create a functional outdoor retreat, while a water fountain adds the soothing ambiance to this tranquil setting. Whether relaxing or entertaining friends and family, the backyard offers a wonderful space to enjoy the Southern California lifestyle. Upstairs, a spacious loft provides additional flexible living space, while four generously sized bedrooms offer comfort and privacy. The primary suite is a peaceful retreat, featuring a transformed ensuite bathroom. The remodeled space includes a spacious walk-in shower, dual vanity sinks with backlit mirrors, granite counters, and 2 walk-in closets. With such an extensive list of upgrades throughout, this home must truly be seen to be appreciated. Be sure to review the list of improvements in the supplements and 360 tour, to fully understand the care, quality, and attention to detail that have gone into making this property so special. From its beautifully appointed interior to its private, low-maintenance outdoor spaces, this exceptional home offers the perfect combination of comfort, style, and convenience in one of Temecula’s well-established and desirable communities. Move-in ready and lovingly maintained, this is truly one of Temecula’s finest. LOW TAXES No Bond Assesments!

results.remarks: ***BEST PRICED POOL HOME IN TEMECULA***TURN KEY***FRESH PAINT***CUL-DE-SAC LOCATION***POOL days, backyard barbecues, and evenings spent relaxing in the spa await at this beautifully maintained home in Temecula's sought-after PALOMA DEL SOL community. Designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining, this home offers the space, flexibility, and outdoor retreat you've been searching for. A welcoming front porch leads into the open living and dining rooms, where soaring vaulted ceilings create a bright and spacious first impression. Just beyond, the inviting family room with a cozy fireplace flows seamlessly into the kitchen, making it easy to stay connected while cooking, gathering, or hosting friends. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a center island, a casual dining area, and a versatile workspace or breakfast bar that's perfect for working from home, homework, crafts, or your morning coffee. A convenient main floor bedroom and full bathroom provide flexible space for guests, extended stays, or a private home office. Upstairs, the primary suite offers a relaxing escape with an ensuite bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, separate shower, and a walk-in closet. Two additional bedrooms share a full bathroom, providing plenty of room for family, hobbies, or additional workspace. French doors open to your private backyard oasis, where a pergola-covered patio overlooks the sparkling pool, relaxing spa, and low-maintenance turf. Whether you're cooling off on warm summer afternoons, hosting weekend get-togethers, or enjoying a quiet evening under the stars, this backyard was designed to be enjoyed year-round. Paloma Del Sol residents enjoy access to multiple community pools, parks, playgrounds, sports courts, and miles of walking trails. Located in the heart of Temecula, you'll be just minutes from shopping, dining, entertainment, award-winning Temecula Wine Country, and convenient freeway access, making it easy to enjoy everything this vibrant community has to offer. This is more than a home. It's a place to slow down, make memories, and enjoy the lifestyle that has made Temecula one of Southern California's most desirable places to live.

results.remarks: BEAUTIFUL HOUSE, NO BACK NEIGHBOR, ON EXTRA-WIDE LOT!!! Well-maintained PASEO DEL SOL house with bonus rooms – perfect for additional bedroom, game room, workout room, retreat, etc. As you enter, there is a grand living/dining area with high ceilings, curved archways, and wrap-around stairway. The kitchen is large and well-appointed with granite counter tops, undercabinet lighting, walk-in pantry, a dry bar, and eating nook. There is a fireplace, built-in cabinetry, and surround sound area in the family room. A large bedroom/bonus room with ceiling fan and double doors is also downstairs, as well as a bathroom with granite countertop. The laundry room has cabinets and laundry sink. Upstairs is the spacious primary bedroom with large retreat/bonus room area and ensuite with dual sinks, shower and separate soaking tub, and walk in closet. The other bedrooms are spacious and have large closets. New carpet has just been installed. Keep cool with the whole-house fan to bring in the fresh air. Step outside and see the extra-wide pool-sized lot with no back neighbor. On the side yard there’s a fenced area with hardscaping and a nice sized tree. There is a wide driveway leading to the 3-car garage. Paseo Del Sol has numerous pools, pathways, sport courts, workout areas, tennis courts, playgrounds, greenbelts, and more. This house is located in the great school district of Temecula – Temecula Valley High School, Temecula Middle School, and the award-winning Abby Reinke Elementary School. Some photos are digitally altered/virtually staged.

results.remarks: Wow - this home checks all the boxes!!!! Single story home on a corner lot in Paseo Del Sol with a 3 CAR GARAGE,  four bedrooms, and a spacious low maintenance yard with a very wide side yard. Enjoy the use of miles of walking trails, five pools, parks tennis, basketball and frisbee golf in the low tax Paseo del Sol neighborhood. Ideally situated close to shopping, restaurants, and the freeway.
